title: Cryo chambers on Mars

tellings.quote: they did report that there were cryo chambers on Mars and that there were people who had been left there

plain: It is said that there are cold-sleep chambers on Mars, with people who were left there. The philosopher Jason Jorjani passes this on from Joe McMoneagle, who worked as a psychic spy, or "remote viewer", for the US Army, and who reported seeing it that way. If true, people from somewhere were stored on another planet.
